title: Silken Thomas
html_source: Thomas Fitzgerald, 10th Earl of Kildare. In February 1534, 21-year-old Thomas was appointed Deputy Governor of Ireland. On June 11, accompanied by 140 mounted elite warriors wearing silk-fringed helmets rode to the St Mary’s Abbey and publicly renounced his allegiance to his cousin King Henry VIII.
